folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B300: gate status, actual means and delivered subset
folds.body:
All original 196 lines were read, including GTR1–GTR35, GTC1–GTC4 and GTL1–GTL13. The opening proposal status controls the new descriptors/rules except for the existing AD/user direction they cite. The later instruction to implement the listed items and their GTL results are selected execution history, not blanket adoption of every subsequent agent rule or later world proposal. The no-runtime-change statement describes the initial proposal pass, not a denial of the later descriptor/herb/inspector delivery.

Preserve guiding through actual means rather than permission labels. A credential has an issuer/record and local recognition; body capacity, knowledge, resources, maturation and social/world facts remain different mechanisms. A source absolute describes its ordinary case with actual supported exceptions, whose costs may include none. Share a justified first consumer seam under AD51 without forcing materially different world laws into one shape. The proposed evaluator/descriptor arrangement is not permission to replace every domain validator or migrate untouched legacy gates.

GTR11's admission, quoted entitlement, continuing support and new stages are separate checks. Do not rescan every admission condition to invalidate paid work, or freeze ongoing support forever merely because entry once passed. Revocation, resource depletion, deadline or source loss settles through the actual owner and declared retention/interruption policy. Learning and earlier earned facts are not automatically wiped. Preview and present display remain pure; an intentional examination/assessment can have its own actual world-defined costs without making every read costly. Player-safe reasons must not leak raw keys, hidden alternatives or sealed counts, including through authored fallback or the inspector's public counterpart.

Overflow policy labels must have actual settlement and relevant readers. Banking, conversion, spill and pressure are available proposals, not already implemented everywhere or permission to create a sink/strain/foe merely to punish power. GTL6 reports a selected per-world single-gain bank/lost policy; GTL10 was explicitly blocked because its intended live-and-source-stated non-Frontier consumer was absent then. That does not block all worlds, prove current absence or dispatch a new pilot. Rate/threshold scaling, clocked gates, directional reset carry and scarce-world ledgers remain local mechanisms rather than universal identical gate records.

GTL1 research inventory, GTL2 source/focused descriptor, GTL3 rebuilt herb inspector, GTL4 proposal map and GTL5 saved-owner Paradise research prove different layers. The 18 focused and 36 rule-behavior passes do not turn the recorded 2,660/2,663 full suite into a pass; its three failures and attributed concurrent-source explanation remain dated, without a new clean control here. The herb waiting7/20 read-only browser case does not prove native passage through every gate or every world. GTR27's old unwired-trial example is qualified by the [high-tier source correction](HIGH_TIER_POWER_CONSIDERATIONS_2026-10-23.md), which records the pledges trial consumer; this pass has not inspected it anew.

Only the Skill-Grinder audit reports fresh bounded text reading in round3. The other four use saved notes, and explicit supplied chapter windows do not mean the stubbed/full novel was read. The MoL carry contradiction, missing characteristic/source consumers, proposed ranks and Paradise penalty conflict retain exact source/era scope. Current book-world/menu priority, compatibility choices, AD36 evidence reuse and AD43 actual consumer floor govern new work. No GTR code, gate policy, user acceptance, source read or runtime verification is added by this reconciliation.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B300: start choices, scoped closure and source-qualified variance
folds.body:
The full original 107-line palette was read. P1's eight compatible axes, P2's five closure scopes, P3's five variation layers, all selection-policy options and P4/P5 considerations remain useful proposals. Unequal/comfortable/powerful, ordinary, child/elder, dependent/nonhuman and retained-knowledge starts need coherent actual means and meaningful actions, not a universal disadvantage or compulsory years of waiting. A language, body, social position or latent faculty is not automatically all the other axes. A generated biography is not player-earned history.

Current [developer-route scope](WORLD_ENTRY_RULES.md#developer-build-through-and-coverage-beyond-the-lead-2026-11-03) distinguishes a protagonist build-through from the default player start. Forced-canon policy can serve that development run while ordinary/alternative lives retain their own knowledge and choices. Lead-path coverage does not close the whole-world denominator. A source-world variation fills qualified unstated facts under its local dial rather than replacing established canon/observed history because a random-start button was pressed.

Task, relation, career, body, world and whole-run closure can differ. Survival, happiness, loyalty, goal and world condition can disagree, while quiet continued life remains possible. Departure or bodily death does not itself trigger prestige, whole-world reset or automatic possession of a defeated person's means. Actual leftover property, custody, rights, obligations and knowledge need their source-supported carrier/recipient. Partial closure and a changed pursuit are useful results. Current activity abstraction can compress repeated spans while retaining consequential choices/history; it does not impose a short campaign or loss of a long life.

World-first and row-first random selection produce different distributions. Preserve optional preference/anti-repeat/pity ideas without silently selecting them or disclosing the sealed candidate catalog through filters/counts. Creation truth, current occurrence eligibility, per-attempt execution and simulated actor choices use their own causes and commitment points. A seed does not promise unchanged values after generator/content revisions; retain committed facts and actual source/definition identity. Preview/load/import is not an implicit reroll. Deliberate reroll and missing-content behavior require their selected local policy.

P5's comparison exercise is a possible bounded design method, not a prerequisite to every small original start or a request to launch new worlds. Old-save proof wording follows the current explicit compatibility decision; current-format consistency and relevant persistence still need real evidence when behavior changes. This palette supplies no source-world candidate eligibility, hidden ending/menu catalog, live selector, stored branch or playable route proof. No new distribution, ending policy, unlock ladder, schema, runtime or source reader is selected here.
